source_table: Table 1, include all rows with experiments completed >0
sampling_notes: Complete cohort of 23 original papers with at least one completed experiment (50 experiments total), not the 53 initially selected papers. High-impact 2010–2012 cancer biology and feasibility/completion selection bias; not random literature, not 23 wholly reproduced papers. Mixed replication outcomes; selected experiment failure does not imply whole-paper invalidity. Frozen membership before grading. External evaluation only, no fitting, selection, calibration or tuning.
